text:
maria: FYI — traced a case where requests re-order after a short pause on the edge. Not a resume token issue; more like the inflight window 'timewarp' when conn goes idle for ~3-7s.
ajay: ugh, can you paste the trace id?
maria: trace=tr_2034 (link) — repro is reliable in staging.
maria: repro steps: 1) open streaming call, 2) drop packets / pause the connection for ~5s, 3) gateway triggers handoff/retry when upstream becomes ready, 4) client receives chunks but order looks swapped for two concurrent partial responses.
charlie: do we still rely on monotonic sequence numbers per stream? should be preserved across handoffs.
maria: we have seq numbers but they're tied to the connection lease, not the logical stream id — so when a lease transfers we reset the seq at the new proxy.
ajay: that explains it — new proxy emits same seq space and downstream merges by seq only. no stable stream epoch.
lin: idea: attach a stream_epoch header that increments on each handoff; downstream orders by (stream_id, epoch, seq). older epochs are dropped.
maria: sketch: X-Stream-Epoch: <int>. Edge increments epoch on lease transfer. Upstream rejects frames with epoch < current. Also preserve an idempotency-key at edge so we can correlate replays.
charlie: tradeoffs: this requires all proxies and upstreams to be epoch-aware. it also means we must buffer a short window to avoid dropping legit-but-late frames during handoff.
lin: we could make the default behavior "resume-only" (no replay) and have an explicit replay permission flag for safe workloads. that reduces side-effect risk.
apps-bot: Note: function-calls are marked side-effecting by default. Manual opt-in required.
maria: also worried about function/tool call duplication — clients depend on at-most-once semantics for those.
ajay: runtime could publish a last_ack_offset during handoff control message. new proxy asks: "accept replay from offset X?" upstream decides based on last_ack.
charlie: alternative is to block handoff until outstanding frames ack, which simplifies correctness but spikes tail latency during eviction.
maria: proposal for RFC: 1) introduce X-Stream-Epoch header, 2) augment handoff control with last_ack_offset, 3) default handoff policy to resume-only for streaming with side-effects disabled, 4) observability: metric for epoch_mismatch_count and replay_attempts.
ajay: +1. also add a warning in console when a handoff triggers an epoch increment for a live stream.
charlie: consider re-using existing idempotency header to avoid schema churn, extend semantics to include epoch binding.
lin: I'll prototype minimal changes in the staging gateway so we can run load tests.
maria: cool — i'll draft the RFC and include the trace + mini-repro and handoff control proto sketch. target: RFC by EOD.
ajay: i'll help with runtime hooks for last_ack_offset.
charlie: i'll review once the draft lands.
ops-bot: deploy queued: gateway/edge staging candidate at 2026-03-21T15:42:00Z
maria: thanks — filing RFC now and will @everyone when ready.
